reasons_add: Qurṭubī says the miser's wealth cannot help him at death.
Qurṭubī identifies the one entering the Fire as the hypocritical Khazrajī and says Abū al-Daḥdāḥ is kept from it.
Qurṭubī places the failure of the miser's wealth at death and says the Khazrajī died in hypocrisy.
Qurṭubī identifies the palm owner who enters the Fire as a hypocritical Khazrajī who died in hypocrisy; Abū al-Daḥdāḥ is kept from the Fire.
